knowledge:
- key_parameters: apply_blacklist=Logical parameter in read_bamfile to filter out blacklisted genomic regions ;; maximum_length=Maximum length of cfDNA to plot in plot_fragment_dist (Default 550) ;; minimum_length=Minimum length of cfDNA to plot in plot_fragment_dist (Default 20) ;; sample_id=Character string to identify the sample in get_fragment_profile ;; ylim=Y-axis limits for plot_transformed_sl (Default c(-20,20)) ;; selected_solution=Integer specifying which CNV solution rank to plot in plot_cnv_solution (Default 1)
- alternatives: QDNAseq=Complementary Bioconductor package for further downstream copy-number analysis ;; Rsamtools=Complementary package for low-level BAM file manipulation ;; GenomicRanges=Complementary package for genomic interval operations
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing shallow whole-genome sequencing data (~0.3X or more) of cfDNA from liquid biopsy sources (e.g., blood-plasma, CSF, urine) mapped to human (GRCh37/hg19, GRCh38/hg38) or mouse (GRCm38/mm10) reference genomes to quantify ctDNA and call CNVs.
- pitfalls: Ensure sequencing coverage reaches the threshold before starting the analysis ;; Input BAM files must be coordinate-sorted and have a corresponding index (.bai) file ;; CNV calling and tumor fraction estimation are performed only on autosomal chromosomes ;; S.L.Ratio values can be highly variable and GC-bias correction should be considered (S.L.Ratio_corrected)

workflows.name: cfdna_cnv_and_ces_analysis
workflows.intent: Extract fragment length profiles from a patient BAM file, normalize against a Panel of Normals, perform CNV calling, estimate tumor fraction, and calculate the ctDNA estimation score (CES).
input: patient_sample.bam (coordinate-sorted BAM file of patient cfDNA)
PoN.rds (Panel of Normals profile RDS file)
workflows.stages: 1. Read and bin the BAM file using read_bamfile ;; 2. Plot fragment length distribution using plot_fragment_dist ;; 3. Extract genome-wide fragment-length profile using get_fragment_profile ;; 4. Plot genome-wide short-fragment ratio using plot_sl_ratio ;; 5. Normalize short-fragmented ratio against PoN using get_zscore_profile ;; 6. Perform Circular Binary Segmentation (CBS) using segmentByPSCB ;; 7. Plot transformed short-to-long ratio and segmentation using plot_transformed_sl ;; 8. Call CNVs and estimate tumor fraction using call_cnv ;; 9. Plot distance matrix of solutions using plot_distance_matrix ;; 10. Retrieve solution table using get_solution_table ;; 11. Plot optimal CNV profile using plot_cnv_solution ;; 12. Calculate ctDNA estimation score (CES) using calculate_CES_score
workflows.code:
library(cfdnakit)
sample_bamfile <- system.file("extdata",
                             "ex.plasma.bam",
                package = "cfdnakit")
plasma_SampleBam <- read_bamfile(sample_bamfile,
                                apply_blacklist = FALSE)
plot_fragment_dist(list("Plasma.Sample"=plasma_SampleBam))
example_RDS <- "example_patientcfDNA_SampleBam.RDS"
example_RDS_file <-
    system.file("extdata",example_RDS,
                package = "cfdnakit")
sample_bins <- readRDS(example_RDS_file)
control_rds<-"BH01_CHR15.SampleBam.rds"
control_RDS_file <-
    system.file("extdata",control_rds,
                package = "cfdnakit")
control_bins <-
    readRDS(control_RDS_file)
comparing_list <- list("Healthy.cfDNA"=control_bins,
                      "Patient.1"=sample_bins)
plot_fragment_dist(comparing_list)
sample_profile <- 
  get_fragment_profile(sample_bins,
                       sample_id = "Patient.1")
patient.SampleFragment.file <-
    system.file("extdata",
                "example_patientcfDNA_SampleFragment.RDS",
                package = "cfdnakit")
patient.SampleFragment <- readRDS(patient.SampleFragment.file)
plot_sl_ratio(patient.SampleFragment)
PoN_rdsfile <- system.file("extdata",
                          "ex.PoN.rds",
                          package = "cfdnakit")
PoN.profiles <- readRDS(PoN_rdsfile)
sample_zscore <- 
  get_zscore_profile(patient.SampleFragment,
                     PoN.profiles)
sample_zscore_segment <- segmentByPSCB(sample_zscore)
plot_transformed_sl(sample_zscore,sample_zscore_segment)
sample_cnv <- call_cnv(sample_zscore_segment,sample_zscore)
plot_distance_matrix(sample_cnv)
solution_table <- get_solution_table(sample_cnv)
plot_cnv_solution(sample_cnv,selected_solution = 1)
calculate_CES_score(sample_zscore_segment)

workflows.name: create_panel_of_normals
workflows.intent: Create a Panel of Normals (PoN) profile from a list of healthy control SampleFragment RDS files.
input: Pon-list.txt (A text file containing paths to healthy control SampleFragment RDS files)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate PoN profile using create_PoN ;; 2. Save the PoN profile to an RDS file
